title: P15.9-B5.2: /app/system/business-admin + /app/workforce/admin legacy admin parity
description: Legacy Business-tab parity on existing canonical APIs only (zero backend/schema/dependency changes). /app/system/business-admin: create business with project_id verified against GET /api/projects (fail-closed when the project list is unavailable — never guessed), pinned ConfirmDialog on the exact payload, ambiguous-outcome wording on transport/5xx failure (no auto-retry, no fabricated success), inspect-by-id rendering the biz.detail() bundle (business/agents/objectives/routines/board work-item columns), global business list labeled global+unfiltered with select/inspect actions. /app/workforce/admin (bound to selected business, EmptyState when none): create org-agent (title+department+role+reports_to+executor_binding; backend auto-materializes baseline contract), create work-item (title+goal+department+assignee+objective+priority; never auto-opened), per-row open/block/unblock/comment through pinned dialogs (open labeled HIGH-IMPACT governed trigger), routine create + enable/disable (canonical mission_schedule seam), legacy objective create explicitly labeled LEGACY compat vs vnext. All mutation dialogs pin {op,biz,target,payload} at open, are invalidated on business change, dup-submit guarded (dblclick → exactly 1 POST), canonical refetch after success, ambiguous wording on transport failure. Same-business-only selects make cross-business reports_to/assignee/objective un-submittable from the UI (backend FAIL_CLOSED_*_SCOPE still authoritative). apiAdmin wrappers added (projects raw array shape verified against server; noAuthPrompt everywhere; reads take AbortSignal). New e2e spec workforce-admin.spec.ts (8 tests) covering the 19-item verification list incl. network-level proof that /app/company reads the newly selected business_id and unauthenticated fail-closed. Proof: tsc+vite PASS; playwright workforce-admin 8/8.
